newsitem.title: USA: Norand Corp sees operating improvement.
newsitem.headline: Norand Corp sees operating improvement.

text.p: Norand Corp said Thursday it expects to see continued improvement in operations in fiscal year 1997.

Earlier Thursday, the wireless data company reported a net loss of $2.4 million in the fiscal fourth quarter ended August 31, compared to a $7.9 million loss a year ago. The 1996 quarter loss included a $3.4 million after-tax charge for settlement and costs of class action securities litigation.

"Management believes operations will continue to improve during its next fiscal year which began September 1, 1996," chief executive N. Robert Hammer said in a statement. "Improvement is expected from higher growth rates in sales compared to fiscal 1996, acceptable gross margins, and continued tight control of operating expenses. The company will continue a high level of investment in research and development to enhance its technical position in client server mobile computing."
